LEGAL INTERNSHIP OPPORTUNITY
Freelance Legal Internship | Delhi

Ardh Sainik Legal Associates is inviting applications from law students and fresh law graduates in Delhi for an exciting freelance legal internship opportunity.

WHY JOIN US?
Gain hands-on exposure to practical legal assignments
Enhance your legal research and drafting skills
Understand professional legal work practices
Work with a flexible freelance structure
Build valuable practical experience for your legal career

📍 Location: Delhi
📞 Call / WhatsApp: 8800001248
Website: www.ardhsainiklegal.com

APPLY NOW
